statements.status_notes: The only fixed release is in the 5.x major line. brace-expansion is a transitive dependency here and is already at 2.1.2, the latest release in the 2.x line. Adopting the 5.x fix would require a major-version bump, which carries a real risk of breaking the dependents that request the 2.x line; we are not taking that risk. We are waiting for upstream dependents to move off the 2.x major line so a compatible fixed version becomes reachable.

The only fixed release is in the 5.x major line. brace-expansion is a transitive dependency here and is already at 1.1.16, the latest release in the 1.x line. Adopting the 5.x fix would require a major-version bump, which carries a real risk of breaking the dependents that request the 1.x line; we are not taking that risk. We are waiting for upstream dependents to move off the 1.x major line so a compatible fixed version becomes reachable.

OpenSearch Dashboards core yarn.lock pins brace-expansion across 1.x, 2.x, and 5.x concurrently. Upgrading 1.x copies to the fixed version 5.0.8 is a major version jump that previously broke minimatch during bootstrap. Plugin-only trees that carry brace-expansion 5.x are bumped to 5.0.8 via yarn/bump instead.
